## AI that works for your firm, not the other way around.

AI is changing how legal teams work. But no single tool can do everything, and the right solution today may not be the right one tomorrow.

## everyday ai use cases.

advanced search in action

You type, “PI cases with rideshare passenger clients settled over 75k,” and AI instantly returns the exact cases that match.

quick catch-ups

Back from vacation, you ask, “What happened in this case in the last 30 days?” AI summarizes the activity so you catch up in seconds.

connect your ai tools

Connect external AI tools to pull data, generate outputs, and feed results back into your workflow automatically.
